mapper.select: SELECT s.*, src.source_name, (SELECT MIN(st.topic_id) FROM zentide_topic_link st WHERE st.signal_id=s.signal_id) AS topic_id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.canonical_name ORDER BY t.canonical_name SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM zentide_topic_link st JOIN zentide_topic t ON t.topic_id=st.topic_id WHERE st.signal_id=s.signal_id) AS topic_names FROM zentide_signal s JOIN zentide_source src ON src.source_id=s.source_id WHERE s.status IN ('OBSERVING','ASSESSING','CONFLICTED') ORDER BY s.discovered_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
